contract.intended_consumer: Coding agents using sanctioned claim bootstrap and recovery
contract.outcome: Claim creation cannot report success for a missing checkout, and a malformed claim cannot block its own exact recovery path.

canonical_journey.starting_state: A native session has no claim, or owns a claim whose recorded worktree is missing.
canonical_journey.input: An exact typed session-start or self-owned session-end request.
canonical_journey.action: Attempt invalid session creation, then exercise exact recovery for an unhealthy claim.
canonical_journey.observable_result: Invalid creation fails before writing state, while exact self-owned recovery remains admitted.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: A missing checkout produces a live claim or the unhealthy claim prevents its own recovery command.

request.approval_text: Brian approved resolving the claim lifecycle defect at the root on 2026-09-15.
